business_summary: Warom Technology Incorporated Company researches and develops, manufactures, and supplies explosion-proof electric apparatus and professional lighting equipment in China and internationally. It offers explosion proof light fittings, including linear light, highbay lowbay light, pendant light, and caution spotlight fittings, as well as floodlights, street lamps, and solar lighting; explosion proof electrical equipment comprising illumination switches, junction and terminal boxes, and plugs and switches; explosion proof control equipment that include position switches, control stations, and control unit systems; and explosion proof distribution boxes, such as motor switches, distribution boxes, and empty enclosures. The company also provides cable glands and bushings, including cable glands, flexible conduits, and accessories; exhaust fans and air conditioners; distribution cabinets and engineering cabins; marine products comprising cabin interior and exterior lights, explosion proof light fittings, LED floodlight search lights, navigation signal lights, helicopter landing platform, plugs and sockets, and junctions and distribution boxes; and water proof products, such as round, plaza, spotlight and floodlight, linear, indoor, and special light fittings, as well as electrical appliances, pipe fittings, and street lamps. Its products are used in oil, chemical industry, natural gas, ocean platform, coal mine, army, public security, fire control, railway, highway, port, stadium, and other industries. Warom Technology Incorporated Company was founded in 2010 and is based in Shanghai, China.
